images.filename: StateLibQld 1 107640 Southern Cross, a Fokker F.VII 3m aeroplane, on display in an enclosure at the airfield, June 1928.jpg
images.caption:
Southern Cross, a Fokker F.VII 3m aeroplane, on display in an enclosure at the airfield, June 1928
Originally registered as G-AUSU, Southern Cross landed in Brisbane after flying across the Pacific from the United States to Australia via Hawaii and Suva. Pilot was Charles Kingsford Smith and the co-pilot was Charles Ulm. (Description supplied with photograph).
